correctness.rationale: The rook graph is the line graph of K_{a,b}; selected induced graph is cluster iff selected bipartite edges form a star forest. Inclusion-maximality divides exhaustively into full original-vertex support and two asymmetric incomplete-support star cases. The first is counted by the two-sort EGF with correction −zxy for one-edge stars; the others by restricted set partitions S_{≥2}(n,k). Component count gives support {a}∪{b..a+b−2} for 2≤a≤b. Independently enumerated induced P3-free maximal subsets of six rook graphs: R_{2,4} polynomial 4z²+16z⁴; R_{3,4} 4z³+57z⁴+12z⁵; R_{4,4} 104z⁴+144z⁵+16z⁶. Mathematical all-parameter derivation, not test logs, supports the theorem.
